# Alison

> > Alison is a global free online learning platform founded by Mike Feerick, offering courses from top publishers and supporting the UN's Sustainable Development Goals.

Alison (operated by Capernaum Ltd) is headquartered in Galway, Ireland, and has become a leading MOOC provider with a mission to make education accessible worldwide. The platform has been featured in Forbes and other major publications for its innovative approach to free online education.

## Key Topics

- Free online education
- MOOC (Massive Open Online Courses)
- UN Sustainable Development Goals
